title: Active-node id and preview-gating logic duplicated three times instead of reusing activePanelNodeId / previewForActiveNode
description: The component already computes `const activePanelNodeId = selectedNode?.id ?? lastSelectedId` at line 235 and has a canonical helper `previewForActiveNode(previewData, activeNodeId)` (imported line 60, used line 587) that returns the preview only when `previewData.nodeId === activeNodeId`. Yet the DataPreview IIFE recomputes the identical expression `const activeNodeId = selectedNode?.id ?? lastSelectedId` at line 586, and the NodePanel prop block hand-reimplements the same node-id match twice more: `previewData?.nodeId === activePanelNodeId ? previewData?.error_line ?? null : null` (699-700) and `previewData?.status === "ok" && previewData?.nodeId === activePanelNodeId ? previewData.preview : undefined` (703-707). These open-code the exact gate that `previewForActiveNode` encapsulates. Consolidating to one `activePanelNodeId` value and deriving `const activePreview = previewForActiveNode(previewData, activePanelNodeId)` once, then reading `activePreview?.error_line` / `activePreview?.preview`, removes the redundant local and the two inline reimplementations, eliminating the risk that one of the three copies drifts from the helper.
evidence: Line 235: `const activePanelNodeId = selectedNode?.id ?? lastSelectedId`. Line 586 (inside DataPreview IIFE): `const activeNodeId = selectedNode?.id ?? lastSelectedId` — byte-identical RHS. Lines 699-707 inline-test `previewData?.nodeId === activePanelNodeId` twice, duplicating activePreview.ts:8 `return previewData.nodeId === activeNodeId ? previewData : null`.
est_reduction: ~8-12 lines; collapses 1 redundant local + 2 inline reimplementations into 1 reuse of the existing helper
behavior_preservation: Behavior-preserving: `activeNodeId` (586) and `activePanelNodeId` (235) evaluate to the same value every render; the inline `nodeId === activePanelNodeId` checks return the same error_line/preview as `previewForActiveNode(previewData, activePanelNodeId)?.error_line / .preview` (the helper additionally guards null previewData/null id, which the `?.` chains already handle).
